title: Team form
purpose: Create a team or change its name, description, default status and whether it is active. Editing needs a reason. The admin role only.
summary: Create a team tickets can be routed to, or change one. Editing needs a reason. One team is always the default, and the default team must stay active.

tasks.title: Create a team
steps: Enter the [[Name]] and, if useful, a [[Description]].
Select [[Create team]]. The team's page opens, ready for its members.

tasks.title: Rename a team or change its description
steps: Open the team and select [[Edit team]], change the details, write the [[Reason for change]] and select [[Save changes]].

tasks.title: Make a team the default
steps: Tick [[Default team]] on that team and save. The previous default team stops being the default.

tasks.title: Stop routing tickets to a team
steps: Edit the team, clear [[Active]], give the reason and save.

good_to_know: Only the admin role can open this form. Other staff roles can read teams but not change them.
A team cannot be deleted, only made inactive. Its tickets, members and history stay.
You cannot clear Default team on the default team, nor make it inactive. Make another team the default first.
If someone else changed the team after you opened the form, saving is refused and your input stays. Reload and review first.

sections.title: Fields
paragraphs: Surrounding spaces are removed before saving. After a create the team's page opens (Team created). After an edit you return to the team's page (Changes recorded with their reason). While a team is inactive, the edit form says so: it takes no new tickets.

items.label: Name
items.description: Required, up to 80 characters. Names must be unique, ignoring case ("Another team already has this name."). A team's stable internal key is made when it is created and does not change when you rename it.

items.label: Description
items.description: Optional. What the team handles. Shown on the team's page.

items.label: Default team
items.description: Tick to make this the default team, which receives tickets whose category names no team. Making a team the default clears the flag from the current one. On the default team the box cannot be cleared: make another team the default instead.

items.label: Active
items.description: Edit only. Clear it to stop routing new tickets to the team; its tickets, members and history stay. The default team must stay active.

items.label: Reason for change
items.description: Edit only, required. Kept with the change in the team's history.

items.label: Create team / Save changes
items.description: Create team saves a new team. Save changes updates it, and is refused with "Change at least one detail before saving." when nothing changed.

items.label: Cancel
items.description: Returns to the team list, or to the team's page when editing; nothing is saved.

items.label: Who may
items.description: The admin role. Others are refused.

items.label: Stale edits
items.description: The form remembers the version of the team you opened. If it changed, saving is refused with "This team changed. Reload and review the current record."

items.label: Inactive teams
items.description: Inactive teams are not offered when logging or assigning tickets, and are refused if chosen. Members can still be added or removed.
